_note: Expansion 4.3 vegetation stress. Built 2026-11-05 by the build agent. Items marked VERIFY are assumptions from docs/fw_4_3_vegetation_stress.md section 5. Path specs: {key, rel} -> path_for(key)/rel, {exp, rel} -> expansion folder. Change freely.

controls._schema: Polygon layer, EPSG:6346, columns control_id (unique), control_type (landing|corridor|old_road_bed|other), optional age_band, soil_unit. VERIFY. Layer name for annotated non-pad disturbance not confirmed

records._schema: CSV record_id, source (complaint|inspection|measurement), date (ISO), x, y (EPSG:6346) or lat, lon (EPSG:4326), coord_precision_m, code, description, lease_id, operator, permit_num, optional ch4_ppm. VERIFY under request R1

audit_blocks._schema: Frozen P2 audit CSV (# header, sha256 sidecar), read only through ek.require_audit. Missing refuses unless --allow-no-audit, then the output is labelled exploratory

folds._schema: CSV block_id, fold from the 3.0 scorer. VERIFY

blocks._schema: 9t block layer 'blocks' with block_id = iy*12+ix, ix, iy

_scenes_note: Held 5 m stacks written by notebooks/wellsight_v2/s5_eval/_nisar_vs_optical_9t.py from Element 84 Earth Search items (ids in 'item', dates from that script). Bands were resampled onto a 5 m grid (average for reflectance, nearest for SCL), so V2 puts them back on the native 10 m and 20 m grids. The stacks carry no L2A radiometry tags. 'radiometry' must then be declared per scene as {add_offset, quantification, processing_baseline, offset_removed_upstream, source}. null makes V2 refuse. VERIFY in docs/decisions_4_3.md

scene_index._schema: Optional CSV scene_id, sensor, date, season, path, cloud_frac. Rows are added to the scenes list above

_scl_note: Sentinel-2 L2A scene classes kept. 4 vegetation, 5 not vegetated. Water (6), snow (11), cloud (8, 9), thin cirrus (10), cloud shadow (3), dark or topographic shadow (2), unclassified (7), saturated (1) and no data (0) are masked, and the code refuses a list that keeps any of them (review 4.3-01)

labels._codes_note: Placeholder code lists, not DEP codes. Replace with the DEP complaint types and violation codes once R1 returns (framework V0)
labels._visible_note: Records count only from the first scene date minus visible_lookback_days to the last scene date. User decision. null refuses

extract._scale_note: Reflectance = (DN + BOA_ADD_OFFSET) / BOA_QUANTIFICATION_VALUE, read from metadata or the declared scene radiometry. The held stacks are DN 0 to 6646 (not reflectance)

_band_native_note: Sentinel-2 MSI native pixel per band. B2 B3 B4 B8 10 m. B5 and B11 20 m. SCL 20 m. VERIFY
_max_undefined_note: Share of bootstrap draws allowed to be undefined. 0 means any undefined draw gives an undefined interval and an inconclusive verdict (SH-01). User decision
